venue: Frontiers in Virtual Reality — Virtual Reality in Medicine
audience: XR researchers, developers, clinicians and others evaluating medical VR applications.
scope: Medical applications of VR and related technologies, including clinical or surgical training, access, engagement and care delivery. General AI or 3D technology histories need an explicit medical-XR connection.
article_types: Systematic Review (includes mapping and scoping reviews)
methods: A mapping or scoping review can use the Systematic Review article type, with a defined question, transparent selection, extraction and synthesis, appropriate reporting guidance and study flow. Review and Systematic Review articles must exclude unpublished material. Resolve the status of original technology-history analysis before choosing the article type.
overlap: Morgan, Patel and Campbell (2025), Practical considerations of clinical XR (AR/VR) deployments, DOI 10.3389/frvir.2025.1517402, already covers deployment challenges, institutions and reimbursement. A traceable evidence map should demonstrate what its chronology and source-linked analysis add.
cost: CHF 2,195 for A-type articles, including Review, Systematic Review and Methods; CHF 1,750 for B-types such as Data Report and Perspective. Fees are payable after acceptance. Institutional support or fee assistance is conditional and unverified for OSRI.
ai_disclosure: Disclose generated or edited text/visuals in acknowledgments and Methods when applicable, naming tool, version, model and source. Authors verify factual accuracy, references and originality; AI cannot be an author. Prompts and outputs are encouraged as supplements.
rationale: Closest specialist readership and a direct precedent for medical-XR implementation work; broader non-XR context and original analyses need a clear article-type fit.
recommendation: First specialist option for Cole to consider once the intended evidence-synthesis method and scope are agreed. Candidate—under review; no selection or submission recorded.

audience: An interdisciplinary digital-health, health-informatics and health-services readership.
scope: Digitally enabled information and communication in health, emphasizing real-world implications. A general XR technology history needs a clear digital-health contribution and generalizable implementation insight.
methods: Review submissions use structured reporting with a study-selection flow, detailed searches and the applicable completed reporting checklist. Review registration is recommended. Valid data, appropriate methods and supported conclusions are selection criteria; a large provisional corpus alone is insufficient.
overlap: Sarkar et al. (2021), Barriers and Facilitators to the Implementation of Virtual Reality as a Pain Management Modality in Academic, Community, and Safety-Net Settings: Qualitative Analysis, DOI 10.2196/26623, covers workflow, resources and reimbursement. Related JMIR XR scoping work (Elser et al., 2024; 10.2196/53129) is in a different journal.
cost: USD 3,350 standard article processing fee on acceptance; Viewpoint USD 2,680. Applicable taxes and optional services are additional; non-credit-card payments have a 7% surcharge. Institutional or waiver eligibility is unverified.
ai_disclosure: The October 2026 policy requires the dedicated AI question at submission and every resubmission; disclosure appears in its own published section, not acknowledgments. Identify tools and outsourced tasks, retain prompts/responses and submit manuscript-preparation conversations as a Multimedia Appendix. Methods still describe AI used in the study. Generated text should be identified in a blockquote, textbox or figure. Human authors remain accountable; no AI authorship.
rationale: Broad visibility for rigorous digital-health synthesis, with substantial competition from existing implementation literature and a demanding contribution test.
recommendation: Conditional broad-reach option if the final analysis yields strong, generalizable digital-health findings. Candidate—under review; no selection or submission recorded.
